description: Mapping between CIS Benchmark Sections (Source Document) and corresponding Metasploit Modules (External Knowledge).

Section_1_Account_Policies.cis_reference: Section 1 includes Password Policy (1.1) and Account Lockout Policy (1.2).
Section_1_Account_Policies.external_knowledge_description: Gather information about password policy, minimum length, and account lockout limits directly from the compromised system.

Section_2_1_Audit_Policy.cis_reference: This section is intentionally blank and exists to ensure the structure of Windows benchmarks is consistent.

Section_2_2_User_Rights_Assignment.cis_reference: Defines user and group rights assignments on the server.
Section_2_2_User_Rights_Assignment.external_knowledge_description: Check which groups or users are assigned sensitive privileges (such as SeDebugPrivilege, SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege).

Section_2_3_Security_Options.cis_reference: Includes Microsoft network client/server configurations (e.g., SMB Signing) and interactive logon settings.
Section_2_3_Security_Options.external_knowledge_description: Remotely scan to check if the SMB service requires signatures (Require Security Signature) to prevent Man-in-the-Middle attacks.

Section_5_System_Services.cis_reference: Rule 5.1 Ensure 'Print Spooler (Spooler)' is set to 'Disabled'.
Section_5_System_Services.external_knowledge_description: Check if the Print Spooler service is running and vulnerable to PrintNightmare.

Section_9_Windows_Defender_Firewall.cis_reference: Configure firewall state to On and block unmatched inbound connections.
Section_9_Windows_Defender_Firewall.external_knowledge_description: Scan TCP ports to determine if Windows Firewall is appropriately blocking unauthorized external traffic.

Section_17_Advanced_Audit_Policy_Configu.cis_reference: Specifies system events (Logon, Object Access, Privilege Use, etc.) that must be logged.
Section_17_Advanced_Audit_Policy_Configu.external_knowledge_description: Extract current Audit Policy configuration via Meterpreter to compare against CIS standards.

Section_18_Administrative_Templates_Netw.cis_reference: Section 18.6: Requires SMB encryption and disables SMBv1 server/client.
Section_18_Administrative_Templates_Netw.external_knowledge_description: Remotely scan the network to detect servers running the insecure SMBv1 protocol.

Section_18_Administrative_Templates_Remo.cis_reference: Section 18.10.57: Requires high-level RDP encryption and Network Level Authentication (NLA).
Section_18_Administrative_Templates_Remo.external_knowledge_description: Determine if the RDP port is open and whether security levels (NLA/SSL) are enforced according to CIS standards.

Section_18_Administrative_Templates_WinR.cis_reference: Section 18.10.90: Disallows Basic Authentication and Unencrypted Traffic on WinRM.
Section_18_Administrative_Templates_WinR.external_knowledge_description: Scan the WinRM service to enumerate allowed authentication methods (flags if Basic/Unencrypted is enabled).
